description: Offline adoption and full PDF replay of the pinned September 2026 Utah center cohort, followed by source-linked internal normalization.
redirect_policy: No network requests. Link recorded source history and replay the unchanged retained PDF locally; historical app acquisition is not asserted.
retry: No automatic retry or refetch. Preserve retained input and completed releases; explicit local rebuild produces a new run.
checkpoint: Raw source and prior prerequisite are pinned. Full selected replay and normalized semantic replay precede manifest-last publication.
idempotency: Exact origin/prerequisite fingerprints, source release ID, run ID, transform version and output hashes; no overwrite of prior manifests.
cancellation: Cooperative decoding and writes; close handles and remove only owned unpublished output. Preserve committed manifests for inspection.
retention_profile: Unmodified internal source document kept separately from center-only normalized derivatives. No phone fields, inferred operating status, address role or geocodes; ZIP5 and ZIP4 remain separate.
